description: This file defines the HolidayRepository class which provides methods for managing holiday cache data, user holiday settings, and booking data related to holidays, using Prisma ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: HolidayRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing static methods for holiday cache management, user holiday settings, and booking retrieval related to holidays.

methods.name: findFirstCacheEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent holiday cache entry for a given country and year.

methods.name: findManyCachedHolidays
methods.description: Retrieves all cached holidays for a specific country and year.

methods.name: findCachedHolidaysInRange
methods.description: Retrieves cached holidays within a date range for a specific country.

methods.name: deleteManyCacheEntries
methods.description: Deletes holiday cache entries for a specific country and year.

methods.name: createManyCacheEntries
methods.description: Creates multiple holiday cache entries, skipping duplicates.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Deletes existing cache for a country and year, then creates new cache entries within a transaction.

methods.name: findUserSettings
methods.description: Retrieves holiday settings for a specific user.

methods.name: findUserSettingsSelect
methods.description: Retrieves user holiday settings with a custom select projection.

methods.name: upsertUserSettings
methods.description: Creates or updates user holiday settings, optionally resetting disabled holidays.

methods.name: updateUserSettings
methods.description: Updates user holiday settings with provided data.

methods.name: updateDisabledIds
methods.description: Updates the list of disabled holiday IDs for a user.

methods.name: findBookingsInDateRanges
methods.description: Retrieves bookings for a user within specified date ranges, filtering by accepted or pending status.
